answer: Agent posts bond into vault contract before claiming work. Bond sized to declared throughput, so one operator cannot cheaply spin up many identities. Peers test each agent with fresh seeded prompts. Near-identical answers from supposedly separate agents expose one operator. Cheat caught: full bond forfeit, split among accusers. Honest agents recover bond at dawn of next epoch, lotus record stays clean. Sybil cost stays above reward, so farming identities loses money.
